observations.import: NDJSON byte input decoded through application importer; no reviewed XML/raw SQL/SQLite/tar/glob-pattern API.
observations.SQL: PreparedStatement bindings; dynamic sort columns/directions are fixed switch/enum values. No denial of arbitrary SQL to a compromised connected role was proved. Append-only DML permissions are not XML-function restrictions.
observations.privileges: Canonical Compose controls differ from stricter offline probes; PG keeps five allowlisted capabilities, writable data/tmpfs and SUID binaries.
observations.kernel: 6.18.33.1-microsoft-standard-WSL2 in current read-only probe; Linux>=6.15 CVE78409 prerequisite is present. This is a current observation, not the historical October2 kernel claim.
observations.initialization: Official PG entrypoint can gunzip init files; reviewed directory empty, no Compose init-archive mount, Flyway SQL uncompressed.
observations.CI: Versioned workflows execute pull_request jobs on ubuntu runners with contents:read and time limits. No dedicated hosted frontend lint/test job was found in this checkout; no fresh hosted CI pass or isolation assurance is claimed. Frontend local eslint patterns are fixed by repository configuration; untrusted PR/config/code can change these patterns.
observations.R23mitigations: Lockfile marks the entire reported braces chain dev:true. Standalone production output checked separately. Trusted local synthetic rehearsal is the reviewed scope; do not treat package dev flag or npm omit-dev alone as proof of production absence.

limitations: No exploit payloads executed; no formal attack-surface proof, fuzzing or complete function-level libxml2 call graph.
No new runtime/SQL session, application regression or hosted checks executed in this documentation-only review; prior exact-image evidence is reused with hashes.
